description: A side extension filling in an existing courtyard in Colchester; the client also explored, but didn't pursue, a speculative new-build plot nearby.

caseStudy.text: Mr Gregory wanted to extend his home at 28 Bourne Road, Colchester, filling in an existing courtyard.
caseStudy.heading: The Brief

caseStudy.text: The design added a side extension over the courtyard space.
caseStudy.heading: The Approach

caseStudy.text: Colchester Borough Council granted full planning permission for the scheme. The client also explored, but didn't pursue, a speculative new-build plot nearby.
caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
